meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Newgrounds Audio: hides the supporter promo, blurs or hides artwork and reviews, can hide scores and descriptions
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13.** Mobile (iPhone UA) /audio rendered in headless Chrome: 30 `.item-audiosubmission` rows, 30 `.detail-description`, 25 `.star-score`. Desktop /audio and the track page /audio/listen/1643436 were read as server-rendered HTML (curl, desktop UA) because the headless-Chrome desktop fetch hit a Cloudflare block; selectors were run against that HTML with an offline DOM engine. Logged out only.

- **Supporter promo**: `.ng-latest-supporter-wide` matched 1 on the list and the track page (LIVE).
- **Audio artwork**: `.item-icon`, featured-tile `img.icon` and `.audio-cover-art` (LIVE). The title and play button stay.
- **Reviews**: `.pod-body.review` held 2 reviews on the sample track (LIVE). Tracks without reviews have nothing to hide.
- **Scores**: `.star-score` (25) and `dl.sidestats[data-statistics]` (1) (LIVE).
- **Related audio**: lists built from `.itemlist` with `.item-audiosubmission-small` (LIVE, track page).

Not verified: logged-in pages, the Radio page, the audio player bar while playing, ad slots (the existing ad rule is generic; no ads rendered for a logged-out headless visit). Newgrounds uses stable readable class names; no hashed classes are used. Class names are English-independent.
